# Rules: keeping, removing and pausing skills, guidance and hooks

## Skills and guidance sections

A skill and a guidance section are judged the same way, each from its own block of [`gate-policy.yml`](../evals/gate-policy.yml); where the blocks differ, both values are shown. Each eval fire runs one fixture on one model with and without the subject: a *pair*. A *cell* is one fixture on one model; its gain per pair is D = with − without (share of checks passed).

**Keep.** The subject is kept when any cell shows D > 0 at 80% ([`skills.benefit_confidence`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L49)) confidence overall, split evenly over the subject's cells.

**No benefit.** A cell shows no benefit when it is confident at 90% ([`skills.retire_confidence`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L50)) that D is below 0.15 ([`skills.objective_margin`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L47)), with pairs spanning at least 2 ([`skills.min_cli_versions`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L51)) Claude Code versions. A cell where the subject makes things worse (D < 0, at the same level) also counts as no benefit.

**Cap.** A cell is fired at most 20 ([`skills.max_runs_per_cell`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L52)) pairs. At the cap with neither test decided, and pairs on enough Claude Code versions, it has *no clear effect*, which counts toward removal like no benefit; on one version it stays *insufficient* and is listed as a `cell-at-cap` work item.

**Ceiling (parked).** A cell whose without arm is confidently above 1 − margin (above 0.85 today) cannot show the margin: it is parked as `ceiling`, stops being fired and does not vote on removal. A high cell still undecided after 20 ([`skills.max_runs_high_cell`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L53)) pairs stops as `ceiling-unconfirmed` (also parked) when its no-harm test has passed and its without arm averages at least 0.9 ([`skills.high_stop_min_without`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L56)).

**Broken fixture.** A cell whose arms both pass at most 0.1 ([`skills.floor_fraction`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L54)) of checks over 3 ([`skills.floor_min_runs`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L55)) pairs is `cannot-discriminate` and left out of the verdict.

**Verdict**, first match: any keeping cell → `keep`; any cell still insufficient or missing → `insufficient`; every cell broken → `cannot-discriminate`; every counted cell parked → `ceiling` (when each shows it on its own runs, else `insufficient`); otherwise `retire`. A guidance section whose section-alone pair is unfinished is `insufficient`. A cell paused by the zero-use rule (below) keeps its subject `insufficient`. The judge's score is shown but does not vote (its margin: 1.5 ([`skills.judge_margin`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L48)) on 0 to 10).

**Guidance only.** Under `pooled-with-current-guard` ([`guidance.rest_policy`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L76)) a section's cells pool pairs made beside every earlier version of the rest of the guidance, and every decision toward removal also needs at least 6 pairs ([`guidance.rest_guard_min_pairs`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L77)) beside the current rest, deciding at the remove level on its own.

## Removal

**Every `retire` verdict removes automatically** while `retirement_mode` is `auto` (today: `auto` ([`skills.retirement_mode`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L60))): a removal pull request opens, passes a fresh-context agent review and merges with no human review. It acts only from the scheduled workflow, one removal per evaluation, and opens nothing while another loop pull request or an agent-stamped removal issue is open.

Exceptions:

- **Owner approval:** a skill whose removal would wait on adam-agentskills' `plugin-runtime-review` (its plugin runs code) gets a `proposal` issue for Adam instead; no agent approves one.
- **Pause cap:** after the loop has withdrawn 3 ([`skills.max_removal_pauses`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L59)) removals of one subject, its proposal issue is filed for Adam instead of another removal.
- **Fleet worker:** a skill the bot cannot remove itself (its copy is in cms-platform or adamdaniel.ai, adam-agentskills' mechanical path refuses, or no write token reached the run) gets an `agent-ready` issue for the fleet worker.
- **Guidance merge window:** a guidance removal merges only inside _agent-guidance's weekly window ([`base-md-merge-window.yml`](https://github.com/Adam-S-Daniel/_agent-guidance/blob/main/scripts/base-md-merge-window.yml); [ADR 0017](decisions/0017-guidance-loop-merges-wait-for-the-weekly-window.md)).

**Unused skills** (reason `unused`, [`removal-policy.yml`](../evals/removal-policy.yml)) are removed, through the same flow, only when all hold: not listed in [`usage-unknown.yml`](../evals/usage-unknown.yml); reaches the cloud surface (local-only removal: `false`, [`local_removal`](../evals/removal-policy.yml#L41)); a current census counting every surface it reaches; zero uses over 8 weeks ([`floor_weeks`](../evals/removal-policy.yml#L40)); and its description's re-read cost over those weeks reaches the value of one use:

    sum over surfaces s of  sessions_s × d × R_s / P  ≥  V

with V = $10 ([`value_per_use_usd`](../evals/removal-policy.yml#L35)), P = 119000 tokens ([`prefix_tokens`](../evals/removal-policy.yml#L36)), R = $3.5 per cloud session and $0.81 per local one ([`reread_usd_per_session.cloud`](../evals/removal-policy.yml#L38)), and d the skill's description size in tokens. For d = 100 on the cloud alone that is 3400 sessions.

## Pausing evals

The eval scope pass ([`scripts/eval_scope.py`](../scripts/eval_scope.py)) pauses scheduled fixtures and resumes them; a paused fixture's decided cells still count.

- **First use:** a skill with no recorded use in real work over the census's last 8 weeks ([`first_use_weeks`](../evals/removal-policy.yml#L42)) has every fixture paused, high stakes included, with no session minimum; they resume on its first recorded use. An unknown census (missing, stale, or stale for any surface the skill reaches) pauses nothing.
- **Usage unknown:** the skills in [`usage-unknown.yml`](../evals/usage-unknown.yml) (`adam-writing-style`, `admin-config-render`, `aws-bootstrap`, `browser-testing`, `ci-watcher-loops`, `cms-stuck-pr-triage`, `code-quality`, `consumer-repo-provisioning`, `disarm-inherited-reach`, `editorial-label-audit`, `finding-unknowns`, `github-actions-sha-pinning`, `platform-release-and-bump`, `post-failure-comment`, `preview-environments`, `test-canary`, `workflow-path-audit`) are never paused or removed for use; their eval verdict is their only path to removal.
- **Ceiling:** after 4 runs since the fixture changed ([`ceiling_min_runs`](../evals/scope-policy.yml#L17)), a without arm passing at least 0.85 of checks ([`ceiling_share`](../evals/scope-policy.yml#L18)) and, when judged, scoring at least 8.5 ([`ceiling_judge`](../evals/scope-policy.yml#L19)), on every roster model.
- **Floor:** both arms passing at most 0.1 ([`floor_share`](../evals/scope-policy.yml#L20)) over the same runs.
- Ceiling and floor never pause a `stakes: high` subject, a kept one, or one whose confidence that it helps is at least 0.5 ([`keep_guard`](../evals/scope-policy.yml#L21)).

## Re-checks and stakes

A decided subject is re-checked 8 ([`skills.recheck_weeks`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L57)) weeks after its newest run, or 4 ([`skills.recheck_weeks_high`](../evals/gate-policy.yml#L58)) weeks for a `stakes: high` one ([`stakes.yml`](../evals/stakes.yml): `agent-contribution-markers`, `data-exposure-in-ci`, `name-becomes-scanner-data`, `pinning-github-actions`, `security`, `test-that-can-signal-kills-every-session`, `consumer-repo-provisioning`, `disarm-inherited-reach`, `github-actions-sha-pinning`). High-stakes subjects are tested first within each planning band. No re-check is planned while the subject's removal is `pr-open`, `worker`, `waiting-turn`, `queued`, `removed` or unknown.

## Git hooks

Each git hook check gets a verdict over the last 8 weeks ([`window_weeks`](../evals/hook-policy.yml#L18)):

- `earning`: blocked at least once, and overridden in at most 20% of its blocks ([`max_override_rate`](../evals/hook-policy.yml#L20));
- `overridden-often`: overridden in more than that;
- `never-blocked`: ran and blocked nothing;
- `never-ran`: no recorded run and no block.

A check with blocks but no override count gets no verdict. Non-public repositories are shown only when at least 3 feed the data ([`min_private_repos`](../evals/hook-policy.yml#L23)). **No rule removes a hook check**: the verdicts are reported, not acted on.
